name: types
facts: The catalog holds 27 diagram types, indexed in reference/diagrams.md with one spec file each under reference/types/
Every cell is that type's own full-width specimen from docs/samples/types/, scaled down — not a redrawing of it
All 27 specimens are drawn in the flat-material style, so the variable across the sheet is the layout grammar and nothing else
scripts/diagrams.json is the checker's machine-readable half of the same catalog, and validate.mjs fails the build if a slug there is missing from the skill's frontmatter
The diagram check class fires only on a root carrying data-diagram, so a hero or a banner is never measured against a type budget
